items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Was he any relation to George? The one they called Pops Foster? INTERVIEWEE: No. No.

ctx.x: Before I forget it where did you get that picture and how long have you had it?
This name is Foster. That's his name. The bass player. Foster. That's the bass player. Is that just. It's a stone on the guitar player. Mmhmm. Stone on the guitar player.
Well Foster and Stone related or. No. No they're not related. No. No.
